title: Charcoal archive: structure, analogue matching and classifiers

text.finding: The archive's structure is charring stage, not provenance: KMeans types follow temperature (Cramér's V 0.61) more than the source collection (0.29). Add Addis and it forms a type of its own. Addis sits on the far edge of the charcoal cloud, matches it at r ≈ 0.78 where charcoal matches charcoal at 0.99, and the burned/unburned classifier's confident 'unburned' is extrapolation: most filters lie beyond its training cloud. Truncated AIRSpec on both sides gives the highest Addis–charcoal r of any transform while scoring worst on every objective check, so the asymmetric chain stays.
